questions.text: Let's start small, please. Two days back she met with her advisor — can you find out what that meeting was actually about?
questions.hint: Check the calendar two days back — what does the logged appointment say?

questions.text: Horizon. So she was telling the truth, and now I feel terrible... Still, those two months I was gone — can you find me the name of somewhere she went out?
questions.hint: Open Instagram and look for a bar that Sadie follows to find a post showing her dancing and smiling at a guy.

questions.text: She's got a twin sister — there might be a few photos of the two of them together. Can you get me that girl's full name?
questions.hint: Open Photos and find a photo of Sadie standing next to her twin sister. Then check WhatsApp or Messages for that person's contact info.

questions.text: Can you find the real reason she wanted that break, not whatever she told me?
questions.answer: Who she is in a room he isn't in
decoys: Extra work shifts at the library
Time to focus on her philosophy studies
Saving up to move out of mom's
questions.hint: Check her conversation with her sister Cleo.

questions.text: During the pause in their relationship, she let someone new in. Could you find his username for me?
questions.hint: She accepted someone's friend request on Instagram. Try searching her email to see if there's an Instagram notification about it.

questions.text: Who is this guy anyway? I've never met him — how do they even know each other?
questions.hint: Open Rory On Tape's Insta profile to find a post with Sadie on the university campus.

questions.text: She's always had a thing for journalists. Can you tell me what he actually does for work?
questions.hint: See if he says anything under one of his Instagram posts about a project he's working on.

onboarding.text: Hey... I genuinely don't know how to open this. I'm Wes, I need your help, and it's about Sadie — my girlfriend.
onboarding.label: Wes

onboarding.text: Two years, the two of us, and it worked — even with the few months I had to spend away for work. We loved each other. That part I'm sure of.
onboarding.label: Wes & Sadie

onboarding.text: Then I came home and she wasn't the same person. She keeps her distance, she's gone cold on me. There's something big she isn't telling me — I can feel it.
onboarding.label: Sadie

onboarding.text: She left her phone behind at mine last night. I'm aware this isn't something I should be doing... But I can't go on not knowing. Help me look?
onboarding.label: Wes
